<!--
Feature requests are welcome but not promises. RetroDB is a solo project
with a focused scope; ideas land when they fit the existing direction and
when there's time to ship them. A clear "what + why" makes that decision
easier — and faster.
-->

## What

<!-- One sentence. What feature or change are you asking for? -->

## Why

<!--
The problem you're trying to solve, not the solution you have in mind.
"I can't easily find duplicates across regions" is more useful than
"add a regional-dupe button to the toolbar" — leaves room for a better fit.
-->

## Concrete example

<!--
A specific scenario that shows the feature in use. Helps separate
"would be nice" from "would actually be used".
-->

## Considered alternatives

<!--
What workarounds have you tried already? Is there a related feature
that almost does this? What about it falls short?
-->

## Out of scope (optional but useful)

<!--
What this feature shouldn't try to do. Prevents scope creep and helps
keep the implementation small. Pass `<empty>` if nothing comes to mind.
-->
